name: Alpenschlössl
beschreibung: The inn Alpenschlössl is located in Neustift im Stubaital and serves as a traditional accommodation and gastronomy offering in Tyrol. The property is situated in a quiet spot at the village entrance, offering views of the surrounding mountain landscape. Guests can enjoy a mix of rooms and a dining establishment serving authentic regional cuisine, including specialties like Kaiserschmarrn and Knödel. The facilities include a private wellness area and sun loungers for relaxation. The inn is ideal for both hikers in summer and skiers in winter, as the Stubaier Bergbahnen are just minutes away. Highlights include its family-run atmosphere and proximity to the Naturpark. The practical furnishings cater perfectly to the needs of active holidaymakers.
